description: This Java class represents the response from the Authorize.Net payment gateway, providing methods to parse and access various response fields such as approval status, transaction ID, response codes, and reason texts.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse
classes.description: A class to parse and handle response data from Authorize.Net, supporting different response formats (AIM and CP), and providing methods to retrieve transaction details and status.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse.RespPositions
classes.description: Abstract class defining position retrieval for response fields and approval string comparison.

methods.name: AuthorizeResponse
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response parsing based on response string, delimiter, and response type.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the transaction was approved based on the response code.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID from the response.

methods.name: getAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization code from the response.

methods.name: getResponseCode
methods.description: Retrieves the response code indicating transaction status.

methods.name: getReasonCode
methods.description: Retrieves the reason code explaining the transaction result.

methods.name: getReasonText
methods.description: Retrieves a textual explanation of the response.

methods.name: getAvsResult
methods.description: Gets the Address Verification Service (AVS) response code.

methods.name: getCvResult
methods.description: Gets the Card Verification Value (CVV) response code.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getRawResponse
methods.description: Returns the raw response string received.

methods.name: getResponseField
methods.description: Private method to retrieve a response field by name or position.
